subject.title: fix: strip volatile output from exec result hash to fix no-progress detection (#93917)

question: Should OpenClaw make repeated failed exec calls with the same stable failure fingerprint count as no-progress and trip the critical/global blockers?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but the merge intentionally changes when agent exec retries are stopped, so a maintainer should own that availability tradeoff.

options.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that stable repeated failed exec retries should stop before burning session resources.

options.title: Defer For Broader Loop Policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want cross-tool breaker or fuzzy-result semantics settled before changing failed-exec hashing.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that stable repeated failed exec retries should stop before burning session resources.
